create_para_crawl_config: create a ParaCrawlConfig builder config for English to a target language translation dataset
build_para_crawl_dataset: build a ParaCrawl machine translation dataset builder with a specified target language
get_target_languages: get the sorted dictionary of supported ParaCrawl target language codes and names
generate_para_crawl_examples: generate translation examples from English to a target language from a ParaCrawl data file
split_para_crawl_dataset: split the ParaCrawl dataset into training splits with downloaded data files
